text:
Nina P: Heads up 11 AtlasCommerce wants a compliance packet before procurement greenlights the POC. They asked for SOC 2 Type II summary, ISO 27001 certificate (scan of cert page), pen-test attestation (signed), and explicit confirmation about EU data residency for logs and KV cache. They also want to know if handing over the docs affects pricing/contract.

Arun V: We can provide the SOC 2 summary + auditor cover letter. ISO cert page (PDF) is fine. For pen-test attestation we have a one-page letter signed by our CISO that states date and remediation status; it omits raw vuln excerpts.

Sam T: Procurement specifically called out "Key management separation" 1 they want to know whether customer-managed KMS is possible for the POC or only for Private/Dedicated.

Arun V: Customer-managed KMS requires Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) and is part of Dedicated/Private contract terms. For hosted POC we do not allow external KMS. That may be a blocker for them.

Nina P: Ok, flagging as potential enterprise blocker. If they require CMK we should surface Dedicated pricing and lead time.

Finance: If the ask is only docs + attestation, no surcharge. If they need dataroom access or full report review, we typically apply an audit-support uplift. If they demand CMK for POC, that needs a Private deployment quote (sales-eng + infra).

LegalBot: Note: full SOC2 or raw pen-test findings require NDA and controlled dataroom. We should send a redaction guidance note and one-page cover. Also confirm export controls for EU transfer.

InfraBot: For their requested external scan we can provide ephemeral staging IPs: 3.9.120.77/32 and 34.201.12.4/32. Staging bucket template and presign command we usually send: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-atlas/poc-uploads/ATLAS-scan.zip --expires-in 1800``` Also set lifecycle to 21 days and quarantined prefix.

Sam T: Procurement also asked whether logs containing PII are retained in EU. Short answer: we can configure log storage region for Dedicated/Private; hosted defaults to multi-region and we recommend redaction before upload.

Nina P: Can Security prepare the pen-test attestation and SOC2 exec summary? Also please draft the one-page cover note explaining redactions and next steps for escalations (NDA/dataroom).

Arun V: ETA: pen-test attestation (signed PDF) and SOC2 exec summary by tomorrow noon PST, pending legal sign-off. Pen-test letter date: 2026-02-14.

InfraBot: I'll provision the presigned URL and open the scan window. Proposed window: Fri 09:00-13:00 CET. I will DM links. Reminder: do not upload to prod buckets; use poc-uploads staging only.

Finance: I'll prepare a short note on pricing scenarios: (A) docs only = no change; (B) dataroom/full-report access = one-time audit-support fee; (C) CMK/Private workstream = dedicated pricing + onboarding.

Nina P: Action list: (1) Security/Arun to produce signed pen-test attestation + SOC2 summary; (2) Infra to send presigned URL + IPs and set lifecycle; (3) Finance to provide pricing note; (4) Sales to confirm whether Atlas signs our NDA or sends counters.

Sam T: Small packaging tip: include a short control-to-product mapping table showing where logging, encryption, and KV cache controls map to product features. That usually answers procurement quickly.

Nina P: Thanks all. I'll collate artifacts into a single zip and include the cover note. Will update thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
